label: batch-29
tail:
Batch 29’s draft definitions and proofs are complete locally. I clarified the stratified integrand and allocation assumptions, added the independence and measurability suppliers used by the proofs, and updated the manifest, dependency levels, and proof contracts. The stratified theorem’s steps now use the canonical phase numbering.

**Scoped checks pass:** precheck (15 items, 0 failures), proof-layout (6 changed items, 17 steps, 0 defects), strict proof contracts (15 items), focused depcheck, rendercheck (17 files), content-policy, manifest-deps, source-fetch (3/3), and coverage (33 harvested results, 0 errors or warnings). Local item levels are consistent: four A items at level 0, five A results at level 1, and six B examples at level 2.

**Owner handoff remains necessary.** All 15 existing Step-1 decisions remain escalated and were not overwritten. The required BCS-25 page and its five A items are present, and I inspected their bodies and proofs; the status snapshot showed batch 28 still in flight. I did not independently review these BCS-25 suppliers or their transitive closure: `def-partial-sums-and-sample-means`, `cor-variance-adds-for-pairwise-independent-random-variables`, `thm-khinchin-weak-law-for-iid-integrable-variables`, `def-axiom-of-choice`, `def-standard-normal-and-normal-laws`, `thm-lindeberg-levy-iid-central-limit-theorem`, and `thm-continuous-mapping-theorem`. Batch 29 does not use those results as logical premises, but the page-level requirement remains unresolved pending the owner’s post-writer check.

The run-wide item-level check is blocked by 63 empty inventories in other pairs. The shared batch-dependency-level check reports a stale input hash; I left that shared record for the owner to refresh after writers drain.

The batch evidence records the work and blockers in [the notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-29.notes.md>), [manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-29.pages.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-29.proof-contracts.json>), and [cross-batch dependency record](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-29.cross-batch-dependencies.json>). The reviewed source coverage includes [Owen’s Chapter 8](https://artowen.su.domains/mc/Ch-var-basic.pdf), [Glasserman’s Chapter 4](https://ai.stanford.edu/~bangpeng/download/book/Monte_Carlo_Methods_in_Financial_Engineering__--_by_Paul_Glasserman.pdf), and [Goodman’s variance-reduction notes](https://math.nyu.edu/faculty/goodman/teaching/MonteCarlo07/notes/VarianceReduction.pdf).
